'''Teniel Waray''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:FCCBF" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|I request your assistance. Please invade this bunker, retrieve whatever data you can find on their biological weapon capabilities, and take down some of their chemists.|Agent Waray, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FCCBF" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the [[Chirq Council]] following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] successfully infiltrated a CorSec agent in [[Jzoro Quanera]]'s Chirq Council cell in [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] and managed to obtain the identity of the nine Chirq Council [[Elite Council|elite councilors]] and the locations of their two secret headquarters.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "The Chirq Council: Moving Up" on Corellia</ref> The Corsec thus assaulted the [[First Elite Council Bunker|First]] and [[Second Elite Council Bunker]]s near Doaba Guerfel.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref> Agent Teniel Waray was assigned to the attack on the First Elite Council Bunker. Agent Solso was tasked to hinder the Chirq Council's research into [[Bioweapon/Legends|biological weapons]]. Waray thus hired an independent spacer who previously worked for the CorSec to help her in her mission. The spacer entered the First Elite Council Bunker and managed to destroy all the Chirq Council bioweapons and collect data about the weapons developed there.<ref name="SWG:FCCBF" /> Eventually, the Chirq Council splintered after the Chirq Council elite councilors were killed by the CorSec in the Elite Council Bunkers.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teniel Waray was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FCCBF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Teniel Waray was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
